simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּחֻרוֹת (H979) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בְּחֻרוֹת (bᵉchurôwth) means youth (collectively and abstractly) First listed occurrence: Eccl 11 9.

definitions.full: H979. bechurim or bechuroth [ בְּחוּרִים ] noun feminine abstract plural youth , plural suffix בְּחֻרָיו Num 11:28 (J; Onk ᵑ6 Ges De Di; ᵑ9 ⅏ ᵐ5 בחיריו Luth Ke); בְּחוּרוֺתֶיךָ Eccl 11:9 , בְּחוּרֹתֶיךָ 12:1 .
definitions.rootNote: or בְּחוּרוֹת ; feminine plural of 970 ; also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים ;
